patch_description:
Replace the random point cloud with a deterministic maximin search specialized for the normalized Heilbronn objective. Three fixed vertices define a convex reference triangle, ensuring every generated point lies in a common convex region and fixing the hull area. The objective is then exactly the minimum normalized triangle area.

The search uses multiple seeded restarts, evaluates all 286 triangles vectorially, preferentially perturbs points participating in the currently smallest triangles, and combines local annealed perturbations with occasional global relocations. Keeping the best result across all restarts makes the returned construction deterministic while substantially avoiding the near-collinear triples produced by independent uniform random points.
